about: How a fight on the tactical board is decided. Read by Python from a byte-for-byte copy in the package (python/gameaikit/dataset/combat_rules.json, so the wheel carries it) and by Godot from another (godot/game/tactical/combat_rules.json); tests hold both to this file. ADR 0007: a number two languages share lives in one file. ADR 0008: a fight is dice, not a formula. nobody_coming is the reinforcement distance of a unit with no friend left: the dataset board's width, further than a fight lasts. strong_against is the counter table for the five walkers, as TacticalRules writes it (a test holds the two equal): the dataset's units carry one of these types (T44), so the combat model can see the counter.
